about: Every screen of the app, from this file (builds from 118). "screens": each screen's parts in the order the app draws them, by the screen's key (the list here is every screen the code has, with its parts named as the code draws them). A part: {"id": "<part>"} draws it; add "fold": true to put it under a collapsible header ("open": true starts open, "pinned": true keeps it open with no toggle), "title" and "icon" (SF symbol or logo:<name>) for that header. Leave a part out and it is not drawn; reorder the list and the screen reorders. Insert anywhere: {"kind": "text", "title", "text"} or "key" (text.json), {"kind": "web", "page": "<site path>", "height"} (a page of the site, offline from the pack, {ADDRESS} {SLUG} {CD} {LAT} {LON} {BBL} filled from the saved address), {"kind": "button", "title", "dest", "color"} (dest: a screen key, web:<site path>, dk:<route>, feeds, card, or https://...), {"kind": "tools", "list": "<tools.json list>", "title"}, {"kind": "header", "title"}. "replace": {"<screen key>": "web:<site path>"} shows that page instead of the screen, or another screen key. "tabs": the tab bar in order, {"id", "title", "icon"}; ids x1, x2, x3 are extra tabs whose "dest" is any screen key or web:<site path>. Screen keys: the ones in tools.json dests and home.json, plus the "screens" keys here. "buttons" (builds from 119): every button the app draws, by the key of its label ("buttonsIndex" lists each key with the label text): {"<key>": "<screen key>" | "web:<site path>" | "dk:<route>" | "https://..." | "hide"} sends that button there instead, or hides it; the button keeps its look. "open" (Orgs tab): {"orgs.<heading>": true|false, "orgs.<heading>/<subsection>": true|false, "orgs.*": true|false}; every heading starts closed when this says nothing. Open or closed, from this file. Hub screens ("hub.<title>"), the map layer list ("map-layers") and Votes ("votes") take an id list here too: their entries in that order, ones left out hidden.
